summary: KKR FS Income Trust Select filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of 183,883.440 Class I shares at $25.00 per share for ~$4.6 million aggregate consideration under its continuous private offering. The offering is exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D, limited to accredited investors. As of May 31, 2026, NAV per share was $25.00 and aggregate NAV was ~$1.005 billion. The company continues its private offering on a monthly basis with a $5.0 billion total cap, having issued ~40 million shares for ~$1.018 billion to date. No special-situation transaction such as acquisition, restructuring, or capital return is present; this is a routine capital raise.
